source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The setup now explicitly requests the expected Offline bits for NNTP, IMAP and EWS folders, including clearing previously modified third/fourth folders and IMAP Trash. These writes occur after the relevant folder-discovery waits and before tasks consume the fixture. Cleanup still passes false for removeAccount's aRemoveFiles argument, so it removes accounts without requesting data-directory deletion. This separates fixture state reset from deleting files; it does not prove a verify pass or a general cache/timer cure.
title: Offline-picker setup resets the fixture before tasks while cleanup keeps its files
